verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only Graph API primitives for developers: apps can set up Inbox rules, define categories, query messages into search folders, and change message importance. These are building blocks a developer could use to assemble streams. They are not a documented capability that splits the inbox into focused streams (important, team, newsletters, calendar invites) for priority-ordered triage. No community or hands-on evidence addresses inbox splitting.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can split my inbox into focused streams — important, team, newsletters, calendar invites — so triage happens in priority order, not arrival order
